name: Image Viewer
description: View images in desktop windows with zoom, pan, rotation, original-size inspection and downloads.

actions.name: fit
actions.description: Fit the image inside this window.

actions.name: actual
actions.description: Display one image pixel per CSS pixel (100%).

actions.name: rotate
actions.description: Rotate the view clockwise by 90 degrees. The original file is unchanged.

actions.name: reset
actions.description: Reset rotation and fit the image to the window.
